comments.author: ancientmako
comments.body_html: One can just edit the globals.json to realize this function. Search “ArmorMaterials” in SPT\SPT_Data\database\globals.json Change all MaxRepairKitDegradation \ MinRepairKitDegradation to 0.0 to get perfect repair of using kits. For traders’ repair, change MaxRepairDegradation \ MinRepairDegradation to 0.0.
